comment: Single registry of repo-VERSION-coupled locations. scripts/ci/check-drift.mjs enforces: (1) every live slot carries the current VERSION (json_path dot-paths support one '*' array segment; regex slots must match >= 1 time with capture group 1 and ALL captures equal VERSION); (2) a stale-literal tripwire — any past-version literal (past versions derived hermetically from CHANGELOG '## [x.y.z]' headings; tags may disagree, e.g. the changelog-only 1.0.1) in a tracked file with a scan extension, outside the historical zones and the exemptions below, fails the gate naming file:line. Exemptions are rules, not zones: tokens equal to any skills.json version (the per-skill semver axis), '@'-pinned tokens (foreign package pins like biomcp@1.1.1), this manifest itself, and the per-file exempt list. NOT governed here: the per-skill axis (skills.json <-> SKILL.md metadata.version — structurally gated), inline dependency pins, git tags/release/tarball names and the website footer (dynamic, derived from VERSION at automation time). When you add a new VERSION mention to the repo, register it here in the same PR.

live_slots.notes: every plugins[] entry must carry the current version; a missing version key fails (coupled registry)

exempt_files.reason: probe clientInfo semver constant — foreign namespace
vendored biomcp pin registry — foreign namespace
